head: Nearly 250 volunteers spent the All Saints' weekend collecting for Warsaw's oldest gravestones.
summary: Nearly 250 volunteers — actors, musicians and journalists among them — carried collection tins along the paths of Warsaw's Stare Powązki cemetery from 9am until about 8pm on 31 October and 1 November, in the 52nd year of the appeal. The Jerzy Waldorff committee that runs it took about 270,000 złoty last year, money that went toward conserving 27 historic monuments alongside 1.9 million złoty in city grants. Forty more gravestones are booked for restoration next year, out of roughly 300 the committee still counts as urgent and about 1,700 saved over five decades.

head: Nine combines turned up to bring in a neighbor's 400 acres of soybeans.
summary: Nine combines, about six grain semis and six tractors with grain carts converged on a soybean field near Walton, Illinois, on October 19 to bring in the roughly 400 acres Michael Mead could not harvest himself after a medical emergency in July. Neighboring farmer Don Meyer made the calls and got so many offers that he started a waiting list; Prairie State Tractor Repair sent a technician to keep the machines running, and the Southwest Taco Truck drove out from Amboy with lunch. Meyer is holding that list for Mead's corn harvest, a return of the ten days Mead once spent helping clean up Meyer's own farm.

head: Over 600 volunteers spent four days rebuilding Pacific Palisades together.
summary: Over 600 volunteers spent four days this week repairing homes, building children's playhouses, and restoring shared spaces across Pacific Palisades, California, nine months after a January fire destroyed thousands of houses there. Habitat for Humanity of Greater Los Angeles organized the push, working with the Foothill Catalog Foundation and the City of Los Angeles, which pre-approved dozens of house designs to speed permits for returning families. The group plans to keep returning in waves as more families secure permits, turning what had been a slow, solitary rebuilding process into a shared one.
